data.text: 26.3 (Vulkan/SPIR-V shaders, resource format 97.1): any pack overriding assets/minecraft/shaders/core/*.fsh|vsh with old GLSL (#version <140, moj_import) fails the reload and vanilla wipes resourcePacks in options.txt. Fix = strip shaders/ from the pack. Just 3d armors 1.4 → patched copy "Just 3d armors 1.4 (26.3).zip".
